classification_policy.legacy-traceable: A specific exact historical URL, layer, item, filtered layer, or annotated dataset identity is retained and linked to the collection, but exact upstream response bytes are missing.
classification_policy.ambiguous: Local evidence leaves multiple materially plausible source identities or does not identify the collection-specific source/layer.
classification_policy.orphan: No specific historical source identity or linking reference remains.
classification_policy.precedence: A retained exact-byte chain is required for historical-verified. An exact dedicated geometry-evidence identity is sufficient for legacy-traceable even when current endpoint state is unknown. Confidence records selector/run gaps without changing that class.
classification_policy.non_invention: Source identities are copied verbatim from retained evidence. URL components and annotations are lossless splits of those strings. No URL or hash is synthesized.
